method: One full-document structured completion jointly selects summary claims, substantive items and optional metadata. Explicit Markdown agenda/list/Action Items relationships and unchanged raw source spans are preserved. No per-line classification, same-model acceptance review, retry or generated repair occurs in this opt-in mode.
review_fixes: Owner/date/priority proof comes from the terminal task unit; collective owner inheritance requires an included, active, actual Action Items ancestor. Intervening siblings and expired blocks cannot supply fields. Unsupported non-null values reject rather than silently changing to null.
Removed a duplicate input-count preflight. The existing generator records the exact development body and measured count, then rejects over 6144 before any completion dispatch.
limitations: Schema and exact spans do not establish complete or correct summary/action semantics.
A parent-to-later-child contiguous quote retains intervening sibling text and records that diagnostic.
Non-Action ancestor field inheritance is conservatively unsupported.
Actual joint-output fit, latency and quality remain unmeasured by these synthetic checks.
